$Comment: How an Effect reward READS where a screen shows it before it pays out. An effect reward
APPLIES an entity effect to the player when it is granted, so there is no item to show;
every one reads as the same generic line instead.
This file is presentation only: it names no Command, so the built-in Effect handler keeps
the payout, and nothing here changes what is applied.
NameKey - one label for every effect reward ('Temporary Effect'), shipped by this library
Icon    - a potion, the shape a player already reads as something that acts on them.
A reward may still write its own NameKey or Icon to read as something more specific. To
re-skin every effect reward at once, ship a file with THIS name in your own pack; it
Name: Applied effect
